shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
human or anthropomorphic face in profile
justification: Both are flat upright slabs bearing low-relief imagery with a framing edge, and both include profile-facing anthropomorphic faces, but that is nearly the extent of it. A shows a grid of stacked, rectangular glyph-like compartments each filled with dense abstracted signs, while B shows a single large winged, bearded figure with raised hand and staff rendered as a continuous naturalistic body with patterned garment feathering — different subject, different organization, different conventions.
